description: This file defines a React component called PasswordResetModal, which renders a modal dialog for password reset confirmation. It imports React, a custom Modal component, Material-UI Button, and a CSS stylesheet. The component displays a message indicating that a password reset link has been sent and includes a button to close the modal.

classes.name: PasswordResetModal
classes.description: A React component that renders a modal dialog informing the user that a password reset link has been sent.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the JSX for the password reset confirmation modal, including the message and a 'Done' button.
